0.2.0.en: Add support for Duo Bulb Gen3 & Multicolor Bulb Gen3

0.2.1.en: Fix light mode change for Multicolor Bulb Gen3 with latest firmware

0.3.0.en: Add LAN support for EM Mini Gen4, Flood Gen4 & Presence Gen4. Add Zigbee support for 1 (Mini) Gen4, 1PM (Mini) Gen4, 2PM Gen4, BLU TRV, EM Mini Gen4, Flood Gen4 & Power Strip 4 Gen4. Add Matter definitions for 1 (Mini) Gen4, 1PM (mini) Gen4, 2PM Gen4, Dimmer Gen4, EM Mini Gen4 & Flood Gen4.

0.3.1.en: Add LAN support for EM Mini Gen4, Flood Gen4 & Presence Gen4. Add Zigbee support for 1 (Mini) Gen4, 1PM (Mini) Gen4, 2PM Gen4, BLU TRV, EM Mini Gen4, Flood Gen4 & Power Strip 4 Gen4. Add Matter definitions for 1 (Mini) Gen4, 1PM (mini) Gen4, 2PM Gen4, Dimmer Gen4, EM Mini Gen4 & Flood Gen4.

0.4.0.en: Add Zigbee support for Presence Gen4, add presence condition cards

0.4.1.en: Fix issue with devices having an Input component after updating to 0.4.0

0.5.0.en:
Add LAN support for 0/1-10V Dimmer Gen4 & EM Gen4.
Add Zigbee support for 0/1-10V Dimmer Gen4, Dimmer Gen4 & EM Gen4.
.Add Z-Wave support for Wave MCB.
Add Matter definitions for 0/1-10V Dimmer Gen4, Duo/Multicolor Bulb E27 Gen3, EM Gen4 & Presence Gen4.
Use TLS encryption for communication when possible.
Stability improvements and bug fixes.

0.5.1.en: Resolve race condition during app initialisation

0.6.0.en: Add LAN Support for The Pill. Updates for LAN devices: added automated rediscovery, added repair flow, use password for multiple devices during add. Stability improvements and bug fixes.

0.7.0.en: Add support for Flood S Gen4 (LAN, Zigbee & Matter definition). Improve battery device LAN connectivity. Fix missing flows for certain devices.

0.8.0.en: Add LAN support for AZ Plug & Plug M Gen3. Add Zigbee support for Ecowitt WS90. Add Matter definitions for Plug M Gen3. Improve resilience of device reboot due to settings update.

0.9.0.en: Add LAN support for FrankEver Smart water valve. Add BLE support for BLU Remote Control. Add BLE forwarding script support as base for other BLE devices. Improved state and websocket error handling.

0.9.1.en: Add missing restart button to non-battery devices, improve websocket reconnection logic.

0.10.0.en: Adds Shelly device error reporting support. Harden local device pairing. Generic implementation updates based on gathered feedback. Note: this release contains breaking flow card changes!

0.11.0.en: Add general information in settings to LAN connected devices

0.12.0.en: Add LAN support for Top AC Portable EV Charger, Hilux DS8, Ogemray Smart Relay 25A, 1PM Gen3, 1PM Mini Gen3, 1 Gen3, 1 Mini Gen3, 1L Gen3, Dimmer Gen3, Plus 0-10V Dimmer & Plus 1. Add support for generic device flags. Fix interaction issue with valve position.

0.13.0.en: Add LAN support for H&T Gen3, Plug PM Gen3, Plug S Gen3, PM Mini Gen3 & Pro EM-50. Add Matter definitions for H&T Gen3, Plug PM Gen3 & Plug S Gen3. Fixed inconsistent naming.

0.14.0.en: Add LAN support for Neo Smart Water Valve & Raex MP46 Curtain Motor. Add Matter definitions for Raex MP46 Curtain Motor. Fix input capabilities. Improve socket aliveness validation. Improve battery device support.

0.15.0.en: Adds LAN support for FrankEver FK-06X Sprinkler Controller, Plus 2PM (switch and cover profile) and Plus Plug S. Adds BLE support for BLU Button (Tough) 1 (ZB), BLU Distance, BLU Door/Window (ZB), BLU H&T (Display) (ZB), BLU Motion (ZB), BLU RC Button 4 (ZB), BLU Remote Control ZB, BLU Wall Switch 4 (ZB) and Ecowitt WS90. Adds Zigbee support for BLU Button Tough 1 ZB, BLU Distance, BLU Door/Window ZB, BLU H&T (Display) ZB, BLU Motion ZB, BLU RC Button 4 ZB, BLU Remote Control ZB and BLU Wall Switch 4 ZB.
